title: Actions upon reception of the MIB

entities.name: Master Information Block
entities.description: System information block containing essential cell parameters including cellBarred indication and ssb-SubcarrierOffset.

entities.name: System Information Block 1
entities.description: System information block containing cell access parameters and scheduling information for other SIBs.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE state
entities.description: RRC state where UE is not connected to the network but can perform cell selection/reselection.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE state
entities.description: RRC state where UE maintains connection context but is not actively communicating.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED with T311 running
entities.description: Condition where UE is in RRC_CONNECTED state while timer T311 is active.

entities.name: cellBarred set to barred
entities.description: Condition where the cellBarred field in MIB indicates the cell is barred.

entities.name: UE is a RedCap UE
entities.description: Condition identifying the UE as a Reduced Capability device.

entities.name: SIB1 is transmitted in the cell
entities.description: Condition determined by ssb-SubcarrierOffset indicating SIB1 transmission availability.

entities.name: Consider cell as barred
entities.description: Action to treat the cell as barred according to TS 38.304 specifications.

entities.name: Perform cell re-selection
entities.description: Action to perform cell re-selection to other cells on the same frequency as specified in TS 38.304.

entities.name: Acquire SIB1
entities.description: Action to acquire System Information Block 1 when conditions are met.

relations.description: MIB contains cellBarred field that determines if cell is barred
MIB contains ssb-SubcarrierOffset that indicates SIB1 transmission availability
When cellBarred is set to barred, UE considers the cell as barred
When cellBarred is set to barred, UE performs cell re-selection
For RedCap UEs when SIB1 is transmitted, UE acquires SIB1
When SIB1 is transmitted in the cell, UE acquires SIB1
Cell barred evaluation applies when UE is in RRC_IDLE state
Cell barred evaluation applies when UE is in RRC_INACTIVE state
Cell barred evaluation applies when UE is in RRC_CONNECTED with T311 running
